name: wise-hirehop-proposal-platform
purpose: Wise internal HireHop enhancement package for proposal authoring, staging kit design, document preview, native item workflow helpers, proposal-page visibility, capacity tracking, project journey visibility, and QTC renderer alignment.

activeScripts.role: Route-aware loader that enforces the shared-module dependency, initializes sibling features independently, refreshes module health after supplying-root replacement, and applies bounded exponential backoff.

lazyScripts.role: Shared selectors, multi-source Proposal Creation depot matching, docked-preview-safe toolbar discovery and a priority request queue providing concurrency control, deduplication, caching, hidden-page pausing, rate-limit cooldown and diagnostics.

Supplying-list QTC V4 preview (document 169, A4) and Job Performance strip with live depot re-evaluation and event-driven recovery after HireHop replaces the supplying root. Job Track inputs are loaded once, then Revenue/CoS changes recalculate locally from every non-heading supplying item using the same displayed row values.
Small native-popup helper for repetitive line item selection actions across all depots.
Shared QTC-V4 Heading custom-field contract, option values, and legacy WisePageMeta compatibility identifiers.
Shared proposal layout catalogue plus PageTemplate and PageVariant value mappings consumed by the section builder and QTC-V4.

Main proposal page editor and HireHop authoring layer, updated to read and write QTC-V4 Heading custom fields with legacy prefix/suffix fallback. Retained but currently skipped by 0-loader.js; set its loader entry to enabled: true when it is needed again.

Full-page Wise capacity timeline, with a home-page entry button visible across all depots, using project-level custom fields, date-range filtering, Wise status controls, and sanitized absence overlay support.

Metric/imperial staging designer for every depot except Proposal Creation, using the shared priority request queue, preferred per-category catalogue calls and conditional fallbacks. The loader does not request this module in Proposal Creation, and its own runtime gate removes its UI if an existing session changes into that depot. Generated rows and visual behaviour are otherwise preserved; writes remain throttled, bounded and Retry-After aware.

Project and job page UI polish that hides Billing and Purchase orders tabs for non-admin users and keeps them visible for admins. The prototype Checklist tab and panel are disabled while their source is retained for possible future use.

Project details page quality-of-life helper across all depots that keeps the jobs list reachable, adds a compact project-info toggle above the jobs grid, and hides secondary project-level timing fields so project dates read as the Wise event wrapper.
Project Journey tab that reuses the native jobs-grid response and requests missing job details only after the user opens Journey, serialised through the shared request queue.

Proposal Creation depot only, using the shared multi-source depot gate. Groups native project fields into Wise Project Details, Project Ownership, Operational Timings, Working Links and System Details cards without changing their values or save behaviour.

Proposal Creation depot only: uses QTC-V4 CreatePage, PageTemplate and Include Heading custom fields for proposal-page thumbnails, with legacy Section:/Dept: and // markers as read-only fallback. Heading data and every unmatched native tree icon remain untouched.

Proposal Creation depot only: restyles the native job details information area into three balanced, responsive cards — Job Info, Job Dates and Times, and Job Commercial Info — with operational subgroups and natural reading order. The layout is scoped to the active Job Details tab and restores HireHop's native content before any other job tab renders. Goods out and Goods in are omitted presentation-only; HireHop's underlying job values and save behavior are unchanged.

Proposal Creation depot only: displays line-level Revenue and Markup for every non-heading supplying item, plus inventory-master RSP controls for master-backed rows. A compact pen icon beside each item line's Revenue opens a standalone Markup/Revenue editor, fully independent of HireHop's reused native item popup and without adding a separate table column. Saving posts only the native tree-derived line identity and item kind, current job routing ID and merged custom-field bag, so Qty, dates, price, memo, parent and other native item values are not resubmitted. Namespaced line custom fields take precedence over generic row properties, and text Markup values support negative whole numbers such as -100. Job Performance reads the same row Revenue and native CoS values displayed in the list for absolute consistency, excluding only structural heading/root rows to prevent subtotal double-counting. RSP selection and inherited defaults depend on an actual inventory/list master rather than a commercial item-type allowlist. A display-only switch alternates the independent Job Performance and RSP Calculator summaries without changing either module's data or selection state. Native commercial data is preserved.

Proposal Creation depot-only bridge for one trusted external HTTPS JavaScript mod. It uses the shared authoritative depot detector before requesting the external URL, validates the URL, rejects embedded credentials and unsafe schemes, supports optional Subresource Integrity, prevents duplicate loading, exposes diagnostics, and isolates remote download failures from the Wise modules.

referenceFiles.role: Copy of the renderer already deployed in HireHop; useful locally for alignment checks.

legacyFiles.role: V1 concept editor superseded by sectionbuilder2.
Older section builder snapshot retained as a manual rollback reference.
